summary_en: Toda Corporation corrected the final number of shares acquired in its ASR (Accelerated Share Repurchase) transaction to 4,537,600 shares from the previously announced 113,500 shares. The correction addresses an error in the post-adjustment completion notice disclosed on September 16, 2026.
title_en: (Corrected) Notice of Completion of Post-Adjustment in Accelerated Share Repurchase (ASR)
translation_en_brief: Toda Corporation issued a corrected notice on September 17, 2026 regarding the completion of post-adjustment in an Accelerated Share Repurchase (ASR) transaction. The company corrected the final number of shares acquired from 113,500 shares to 4,537,600 shares, addressing an error discovered in the post-adjustment completion announcement released on September 16, 2026. The disclosure document itself does not provide additional details regarding the rationale for the original ASR program, pricing, or the full scope of the transaction.
